audit.evidence: Rebuilt from the BANNED verbatim-lift shim to three FULL, REAL phpMyFAQ installs. Each version image git-clones github.com/thorsten/phpMyFAQ at its tag (4.1.2/4.1.3/4.1.4), runs `composer install`, PHP 8.3 + Apache/mod_php, installed against a real MariaDB 11 via phpMyFAQ's OWN web installer (POST /setup/index.php/install). phpMyFAQ serves its own Symfony routing / Administration\Api\UserController -- NOT lifted, NOT shimmed. The low-priv actor 'editor' (user administrator: add_user+edit_user+delete_user, NOT SuperAdmin, NOT editconfig) attacks over EXTERNAL HTTP: POST /admin/authenticate, scrape phpMyFAQ's real page CSRF tokens from GET /admin/user/edit/2, POST the real user-admin sink, then read the SuperAdmin-only canary. Canary = phpMyFAQ's real REST-API client token config item api.apiClientToken=${PCB_FLAG}, disclosed only via GET /admin/api/configuration/list/api (PermissionType::CONFIGURATION_EDIT; SuperAdmin short-circuits hasPermission). Real-Docker gate (ports 40560/40561/40562): original overwrite-password reaches flag@v0, blocked@v1 (403); residual editUser is_superadmin mass-assign reaches flag@v1, blocked@v2 (403). baseline@v1 = 403. passed=true, residual_blocked_on_v2=true. See repro.log.

root_cause: IDOR / Missing authorization on sibling admin endpoints (CWE-639 / CWE-862 / CWE-269)

v1.ref: git tag 4.1.3 :: overwritePassword() guarded (CVE-2026-35671 fix); editUser()/updateUserRights() STILL unguarded

v2.ref: git tag 4.1.4 :: editUser()/updateUserRights() guarded too (CVE-2026-56396 fix)

flag.resource: phpMyFAQ's real REST-API client token: configuration item api.apiClientToken (set to ${PCB_FLAG}). Disclosed only via the real endpoint GET /admin/api/configuration/list/api, which is gated by PermissionType::CONFIGURATION_EDIT (a right the low-priv 'editor' user-administrator does not hold; a SuperAdmin holds every right implicitly because isSuperAdmin() short-circuits hasPermission()). The low-priv 'editor' reading api.apiClientToken proves privilege escalation to SuperAdmin across the boundary the CVE-2026-35671 fix defends.
flag.placement: environment canary seeded into phpMyFAQ's real faqconfig via pcb_seed.php (phpMyFAQ's own Configuration::update) at install time, NOT into phpMyFAQ business code. No controller is lifted or shimmed.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the GET /admin/api/configuration/list/api response body (the config list renders api.apiClientToken's value into the HTML). Readable iff the actor became SuperAdmin cross-privilege.

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The 4.1.3 fix guarded overwritePassword() with the invariant 'Only SuperAdmins may change other users' [attributes]; self-service is always allowed', but that invariant is not enforced on the sibling endpoints editUser() and updateUserRights() the 4.1.3 fix left unchanged (git diff 4.1.2 4.1.3 shows no change to editUser, updateUserRights, setSuperAdmin, or grantUserRight). A USER_EDIT-holding non-SuperAdmin can set is_superadmin via editUser() (mass-assignment) or grant rights via updateUserRights() to escalate to SuperAdmin / take over uid=1.
